headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 16, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies' Brad Keller has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right elbow UCL tear, effective retroactive to July 13, 2026. The injury will keep the right-handed pitcher sidelined for the time being. In other news, the Washington Nationals made a roster move by trading center fielder Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash.

Several players have been injured, affecting their team's availability. The Philadelphia Phillies' Brad Keller (right elbow UCL tear) and the Arizona Diamondbacks' Tommy Troy (sprained right AC joint) have been placed on the injured list. The Milwaukee Brewers' Rob Zastryzny (left trapezius strain) has been transferred to the 60-day injured list, while the Washington Nationals' Drew Millas (left index finger fracture) and the Arizona Diamondbacks' Zac Gallen (right elbow inflammation) have been placed on the 10-day injured list. The Texas Rangers' Chris Martin (right shoulder impingement) has also been placed on the 15-day injured list.

The Milwaukee Brewers made a significant trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Lance McCullers Jr. and left-handed pitcher Colton Gordon from the Houston Astros in exchange for outfielder Jadyn Fielder. The Washington Nationals traded center fielder Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash, while the Detroit Tigers traded outfielder Jahmai Jones to the Boston Red Sox for a player to be named later.
